title: Assistant Area Manager - FPD (Thiruvananthapuram)
description: Job PurposeThe purpose of this job is to ensure achievement of business targets and enhancement of profitability of the assigned FPDs by providing effective leadership, monitoring people performance, & ensuring timely operations & providing support to ensure smooth functioning.The product portfolio includes broking, mutual funds, life insurance, health insurance, cards and loans.Job Context & Major ChallengesAditya Birla Money Ltd. (ABML) is primarily a Broking Company that deals in Equity, Commodity & Currency. Workforce of ~800 spread across ~40 locations with customer base of more than 3 lacs. ABML is one of the leading securities trading companies in the country. ABML operates in a fragmented equity broking business and has a daily turnover of close to 3,000 Crores with a market share of 1%. Financial Product Distribution Channel of ABM will cater to the dynamic needs of the market for different products like Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Mutual Fund, etc. Through this new channel, ABM is venturing into the budding domain of multiplicity that works on the principle of “supplying after understanding demand”. The channel will work in sync with the units of ABC whose primary products will be in our product range.Key Result AreasKRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)KRA1 Team Building, Engagement & Development To build a Sales Driven proactive team and enhance their capabilities by regularly imparting relevant knowledge and skills required for the FPDs to achieve their goals efficiently. Meeting the Competition Teams and doing Competition Talent Mapping. Engaging the FPDs and keeping themKRA2 To ensure effective risk management & policy adherence To ensure adherence of all regulatory compliances & critical policies set by the company.KRA3 To ensure customer management & engagement To plan and execute local area programs and referrals programs To focus on retention of customers, higher revenue generation and referral activities. To continuously scan the local market penetration & competitive offerings & report on emerging trends for different product lines. To ensure client records are up to date in terms of financial details & contact ability To ensure speedy resolution of client queries and grievances to maximize satisfaction levelsKRA4 To effectively manage day to day team administration and operations for smooth functioning of the team To monitor and foster all daily operations of the team To handle a team of Financial Product Distributors and motivate them in target achievements.KRA5 To ensure training and development for team effectiveness Ensure all the FPDs in the team attend the training timely and effectivelyKRA6 Achieve the revenue growth & profitability to upscale the team To drive the sales targets for the team and build teams as per company’s annual target and over all objectives. To focus on Revenue & Profitability with achievement of target and Yield management. To plan and execute various team level initiatives to ensure business momentum and direction. To engage in new and innovative business planning activities to increase client acquisition and team profitability. To monitor individual and team performance and take steps to improve productivity and correct deviations if any.

title: Accountant Manager
description:
**Position:**
Accountant Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Trivandrum, Kerala (Onsite)
  
  
**Experience:**
2 5 Years
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Accountant Manager to oversee daily accounting operations, financial reporting, and compliance activities. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of accounting principles, taxation, financial management, and statutory requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger entries.
* Prepare and review financial statements, monthly reports, and account reconciliations.
* Monitor cash flow, expenses, and financial transactions to ensure accuracy.
* Handle GST returns, TDS, and other applicable statutory compliance requirements.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
* Maintain accurate financial records and ensure proper documentation.
* Coordinate with auditors, banks, vendors, and internal departments as required.
* Ensure timely processing of invoices, payments, and expense claims.
* Review financial data and identify discrepancies or opportunities to improve processes.
* Assist management with financial analysis and reports for business decisions.

Required Qualifications and Skills
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* 2 5 years of relevant experience in accounting and financial operations.
* Good knowledge of accounting principles, GST, TDS, and applicable tax regulations.
* Experience with accounting software such as Tally, Zoho Books, or similar systems.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and financial reporting.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and the ability to meet reporting deadlines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience in financial reporting, account reconciliation, and statutory compliance.
* Knowledge of auditing procedures and financial controls.
* Experience managing accounting records and coordinating with external auditors.

Work Location
  
  
Trivandrum, Kerala Work from Office.
